init_tensorvm_split: create a TensorVMSplit model with bounding box, grid size, and time size parameters for static 3D scene representation
init_tensorvm_time_embedding: create a TensorVMSplit_TimeEmbedding model with MLP layers for dynamic 3D scene representation with temporal awareness
compute_density_feature: compute density features from sampled 3D coordinates using plane and line coefficient basis decomposition
compute_app_feature: compute appearance features from sampled 3D coordinates using basis matrix projection on decomposed coefficients
warp_coordinate: warp 3D coordinates using time-conditioned MLP to predict spatial displacement for dynamic scene deformation
